parole.significato: A peach palm (Bactris gasipaes), a South American palm tree.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Trinidadian Creole English peewa, peewah, from Spanish pijguao (Latin America), possibly from Quechua [Term?]. The English word is cognate with Spanish pifá, pivá (Panama), pijuayo (Peru).

parole.significato: The andiroba or crabwood tree (Carapa guianensis).
parole.testo: Borrowed from Trinidadian Creole English crappo, crapaud, a modification of either Lokono carapa, kálaba, karaba, or Kari'na karapa. Cognates * Dutch krapboom * Sranan Tongo krapa
